lines.en: : LADIES AND GENTLEMEN...
: WELL, ALL LADIES. SEEING AS THE ONLY GENTLEMAN IN THE ROOM HAS WALKED IN ALONGSIDE ME, MOLLY MACCORMACK.
: Is this really necessary?...
: How would you all like a chance...
: To make your dreams come true?
: What is going on right now?
: Friends. Companions. Stray adventurers looking to stable your pets-
: I hold in my hand the key to everything you have ever wanted.
: And I speak not of an elixir that will turn you into the Molly MacCormack you all saw on Halloween.
: In fact, this bottle holds nothing at all.
: NOTHING BUT DREAMS.
God I hate Christmas.
: Wow, Molly seems passionate. Even by her standards.
: Um...bottles can’t actually hold dreams, can they?...
: I don’t know what she’s talking about.
: Me neither. But I guess we can just wait to see how this plays out.
: Oh no.
: He let Molly choose.
: Let her choose what? The present he forgot about?
: I mean, it’s better to get her opinion than just letting him get something on his own, isn’t it?
: At least she’s a girl.
: It’s better than 700 Yen worth of pocket change.
: Yeah, we’ll see about that.
: Now, I suppose you’re likely wondering how a bottle can hold dreams.
: Sana, she read your mind! It’s one of her powers!
: Shh! I’m listening!
: Under most circumstances, thoughts like that would make sense. I mean, it’s just a bottle. How can it hold anything other than milk or Guinness?
: Bottles hold more than-
: Silence, Sir. You have entrusted the present you forgot about to me, so I must take it in my own hands to make the dreams of one lucky girl (Preferably me) come true!
: And she flat out just told everyone he forgot...
: Really, Molly?
: Friends, take a look around you.
: We’re all gathered here, listening to Western Christmas music, eating food from a Western food chain, celebrating a Westernized holiday...
: Wouldn’t you say it would be beneficial to all of us if we were to break out another classic Western game in...
: Spin the bottle?...
: So that’s your game, Molly MacCormack.
: Failure is not an option, Chika.
: You will spin the bottle. And you will win.
: I know you’re looking at me, Futaba.
: You heard nothing.
: Yeah...
: Um...good luck?
: I don’t need luck. Victory will be mine.
: Um...Ayane?
: What happens when you spin the bottle?
: It’s a game Western [teens] used to play in like, the 80’s.
: Someone goes up and spins the bottle and they need to kiss whoever the bottle points at when it’s done spinning.
: They have to...what?
: I’m just as worried as you. Well, probably more worried.
: If anyone spins the bottle, they have almost a 10%% chance of having it land on Sensei.
: If I see anyone but me kiss him, I will literally explode.
: I hate the thought of it so much that I even broke out percentages.
: Did you know I’m actually smart, Sana? I bet you didn’t know that.
: But...I don’t...want to kiss...anyone here...
: Well, that’s reassuring for me at least. Thank you for being such a good girl.
: I want to go home...
: Sensei! What is the meaning of this?!
: Why are you forcing such a lecherous game on us instead of actually getting a real present?!
: I know what you’re thinking, but it really wasn’t me this time.
: So you didn’t forget to buy a present for someone?
: Okay, that part was me. But the bottle thing was all Molly.
: Likely story.
: What are you going to do if someone spins it and it lands on you?
: Well I mean, I have to abide by the rules at that point, right?
: Excuse me?
: You’re really gonna just lock lips with somebody smack-dab in the middle of our Christmas party?
: As if I’d ever let that happen...
: Yeah, even I don’t like the sound of that and I normally just let stuff like this happen.
: How often have you been faced with scenarios like this, Miku?
: Heck if I know. Just don’t friggin’ kiss anybody in the middle of our party.
: Can one bottle truly possess so much power?
: Leave it to the Emerald Guardian of the Crystal Forest to make all of our dreams come true.
: Hehehe~ Looks like this party has a chance to get interesting after all. Way to go, Irish girl.
: Ki...Ki...Kirin...
: It is...past our b-b-b-bed time...
: We need to be heading...home...before...one of us gets...p...p...pregnant.
: No way, sis. We can’t leave now. We finally got to the good part.
: If the bottle lands on me, I can finally go to Virginia.
: What?
Molly walks up to the table, bottle in hand, and prepares to make the first spin.
I accompany her, crouching down to get a better look at the spin because, let’s face it, I’m excited too.
There’s literally no way I can lose this game.
But I should probably be sure she’s okay with putting what I assume is her first kiss entirely in the hands of fate.
: Are you sure you want to do this?
: Of course, Sir.
: You have bestowed upon me the chance to make my dreams come true. To finally become the lead heroine! And in front of everyone else at that!
: I accept my fate regardless of the outcome, for if there are higher powers out there, they shall truly force the two of us together!
: You two? Really? Yeah, not happening.
: Good luck, Irish girl!
: If you spin it really softly, it’s sure to land on Sensei!
: D...DON’T...SPIN!
: BOTTLES ARE...BAD!
: Good luck, Emerald Guardian. If we have to kiss, please be gentle.
: Molly MacCormack requires no luck. She has been putting all of her points into that since the beginning of time.
: I carry with me the heart of my homeland! The luck of the Irish!
: And so I put this in the hands of the fae! Gift unto me a dream come true!
: Phew. It landed on Rin.
: Does this mean...Molly and Rin are going to kiss?...
: But they’re on opposite factions. It would never work.
: It’s fine, Kendo Princess...
: If this is what fate has in store for me, I must accept.
: Uhhhhhhhhhhhhhh...
: What?
: What are you doing?
: Why are you touching me?
: Is there something on my face? Are you checking to see if I have a fever?
: No, Rin...
: I’m simply moving the way the world dictates that I must move.
: Hmm...okay, okay.
: I speak Molly, so I should be able to figure out what that means.
: You walked in here yelling something about fate...
: And a bottle that carried...dreams...
: And now you’re here...and you’re...moving the way...the world...dictates?...
: DON’T YOU DARE, MOLLY!
: IT’S JUST A GAME! YOU DON’T ACTUALLY HAVE TO-
: FOR IRELAND!
: NO! NOT FOR IRELAND!
: MMMMMM!!!!!
: Chu~
: WHY?!
: We are now bonded for life.
: THAT ISN’T HOW KISSING WORKS!
: I WAS SAVING MY LIPS FOR SOMEONE ELSE!
: AM I NOT GOOD ENOUGH FOR YOU?!
: YOU’RE NOT MY TYPE! YOU KNOW THIS!
: Did that really just happen?
: Yeah...
: Does...this mean Rin is over me now?
: I don’t think so...this kind of happened against her will?
: Aren’t we supposed to call the police if something like this happens?
: I...don’t know.
: I’ve never dealt with this before.
: Okay, okay. Time to let a real warrior spin.
: You too?
: The chance of having to kiss a girl can not outweigh the sub-10%% chance I have to kiss you in front of everyone, Sensei.
: This is a risk I must take, beloved future-husband. And I need you to believe in me.
: Okay, but I believed in Molly and she wound up kissing Rin.
: I saw. It was pretty awesome.
: Well, good luck I guess.
: I can’t believe I’m actually letting this happen right now.
: Huh.
: That looks like it’s pointing right at me.
: Probably because it is pointing right at you.
: That can’t be true. It would mean I have to kiss Ayane.
: Well...I guess this is less awkward than having to kiss Yumi or something.
: On the bright side, at least it won’t be the first time you two have kissed.
: What are you talking about?! Ayane and I have never-
Ayane jumps over the table to get to Ami and quickly pulls her body toward her, locking her into a kiss.
Sana, who I assume had instinctively followed Ayane out of sheer habit, is now frozen solid and unsure of what to do.
And, in other news, I suddenly have an erection.
: Why...are all of my friends...kissing other girls?...
: Hah...
: Christmas is exhausting.
: So beautiful.
: I wish them a happy life together.
: I’ll be right back.
: I’m gonna go do something.
: Don’t you fucking dare.
: But I need to make dreams come true.
: Sensei...
: I’m sorry, Makoto.
: I can’t let Molly down on Christmas.
Spin hard
: Ah!
: It landed on me!
: Weren’t you just halfway across the room two seconds-
: I’ve been here the whole time.
: You have to kiss me now, right? That’s how this works?
: Why aren’t you kissing me yet?
: Again, don’t fucking dare.
: But she won fair and square. I need to give her something.
: How about an actual present because, you know, it’s Christmas?
: Can we at least...take a walk together or something?
: Through the halls of a hotel? Romantic.
: I’ll go on a walk!
: I mean I obviously wouldn’t actually kiss Sensei, especially in front of the entire class- so a walk is fine!
: You literally just complained about him taking too long to kiss you.
: That never happened. You need to get your ears checked.
: Whatever. Go for your stupid walk.
: But be back in ten minutes or I’m calling security and telling them there’s an older man taking advantage of a[school] girl.
: Twenty minutes and I promise not to tell anyone what I found in your locker that one time.
Wait, what was in Makoto’s locker? Now I’m kind of curious.
: Fine. Twenty minutes. But no more. Got it?
: Got it! Thanks class prez!
Chika springs up faster than I’ve ever seen her move before and throws the door open, dragging me along before Ami and Ayane are able to snap out of their post-kiss...depression?
They definitely did not look very happy.
But hey, if them being sad for a little while is the only negative aftereffect of getting to watch them kiss, I’m completely fine with it.
Spin soft
: Absolutely not.
: Spin it again.
: Fine...
